title: Sitemap Indexes and the Sitemaps Cache | Orchard Core
description:
Search engines limit how large one sitemap can be, so a big site needs several sitemaps. Each one then needs to be found, and the files Orchard Core builds for them need to be managed.

A sitemap index groups your sitemaps under a single address. The Sitemaps Cache holds the file built for each sitemap, and the Sitemaps Cleanup feature removes the files that are no longer used.
